conditions: Signed-in customer navigates to a product detail page
Customer clicks the Add to Favourites button
Customer navigates to the favourites list page
items.expected: The Add to Favourites button changes state (e.g. becomes active/filled) to confirm the action; the product appears in the favourites list

conditions: Signed-in customer has at least one product in their favourites list
Customer clicks the Remove button for that product on the favourites page
items.expected: The remove action is confirmed (e.g. button interaction is acknowledged); the product is no longer displayed in the favourites list

conditions: Visitor who is not signed in navigates directly to the favourites page
items.expected: The visitor is redirected to the sign-in page and no favourites are shown

conditions: Visitor who is not signed in attempts to access the favourites page directly via URL
items.expected: The visitor is redirected away from the favourites page and lands on the sign-in page; no favourite items are accessible without authentication

conditions: Signed-in customer is on the favourites page
items.expected: The favourites page passes axe accessibility checks with no violations

excluded.reason: TOOL-21 is about admin product search not narrowing results — unrelated to customer favourites functionality tested by this story
TOOL-20 is about the billing address step not being pre-filled from customer profile — unrelated to the favourites list feature tested by this story
Neither open bug (TOOL-21, TOOL-20) touches this story's behaviour; no confirmation tests are needed here
